# Setup

1. Install original rCube package from Gagneur lab into "temporary" library. This is a workaround
to access the vignette in PDF form. (I have yet to figure out how to build the vignette PDF from the
sweave file (vignette/rCube.Rnw).) Note that this package is never loaded via `library(rCube)`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
lib_bioc <- "D:/Documents/R/4.2/bioc" # Bioconductor library
lib_tmp <- "D:/Documents/R/4.2/tmp"   # Temporary library for rCube

# add Bioconductor library to .libPaths so that rCube dependencies are recognized
.libPaths(c(lib_tmp, lib_bioc, .libPaths()))

# install rCube package in temporary library
if (!dir.exists(lib_tmp)) {
  dir.create(lib_tmp)
}
if (! "rCube" %in% rownames(installed.packages(lib.loc = lib_tmp))) {
  devtools::install_github("https://github.com/gagneurlab/rCube", lib = lib_tmp)
}
```

2. Load the rCube package based on modified code.

Bugs fixed
- Use `withDimnames=FALSE` argument when calling `SummarizedExperiment::assay` and
`SummarizedExperiment::assays` due to changes in version 1.18.0 of `SummarizedExperiment` package
(see https://github.com/Bioconductor/SummarizedExperiment/blob/master/NEWS)
- 

```{r}
# path to rCube repository (e.g., after using git clone https://github.com/gagneurlab/rCube.git)
path_rCube <- "D:/Documents/Projects/forked_repos/rCube"
devtools::load_all(path_rCube)
```

# T-Cell Activation Dataset Tutorial

## Load data

```{r}
data("exampleExons")
constitutiveExons <- createConstitutiveFeaturesGRangesFromGRanges(
  exampleExons,
  BPPARAM = NULL,
  ncores = 1)
```

```{r}
folder <- system.file("extdata/TcellActivation", package="rCube")
expDesign <- read.delim(file.path(folder, "experimentalDesign.txt"))
expDesign$filename <- purrr::map_chr(expDesign$filename, ~ file.path(folder, .))
exonCounts <- setupExperiment(constitutiveExons, designMatrix=expDesign, files=NULL)
```

```{r}
exonCounts <- countFeatures(exonCounts)
```

```{r}
data("spikeins")
data("spikeinLabeling")
spikeinLengths <- width(spikeins)
```

```{r}
spikeinCounts <- setupExperimentSpikeins(
  rows = spikeins,
  designMatrix = expDesign,
  length = spikeinLengths,
  labelingState = spikeinLabeling)
spikeinCounts <- countSpikeins(spikeinCounts)
```

## Estimate size factors from spike-ins

```{r}
exonCounts <- estimateSizeFactors(exonCounts, spikeinCounts, method = "spikeinGLM")
```

## Estimate dispersion for each gene

```{r}
exonCounts <- estimateSizeDispersions(exonCounts, method = "DESeqDispGeneEst")
```

## Exon-specific synthesis and degradation rate estimates

```{r}
elementMetadata(exonCounts)$numberOfIterations <- 7

rates <- estimateRateByFirstOrderKinetics(
  exonCounts,
  replicate = c(1, 2, "1:2"),
  method = "single",
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(1))

assay(rates) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "feature") %>%
  pivot_longer(-feature) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = str_split_i(name, "_", 1),
    Rate = str_split_i(name, "_", 2),
    Replicate = str_split_i(name, "_", 3)) %>% 
  select(feature, Condition, Rate, Replicate, value) %>% 
  arrange(feature, Condition, Rate, Replicate)
```
